name: SigLIP: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training (arXiv:2303.15343)
notes: ICCV 2023 Oral. SigLIP SO400M (the variant used in PaliGemma and Gemma vision towers) has ~400M parameters. At 224x224, the SigLIP SO400M vision tower costs ~41 GFLOPs per image. The paper focuses on training loss, not inference cost, but the architecture is what ships in production VLMs.
